dash.leverage_hint: The multiple by which position size grows relative to margin. Higher leverage means you can open a larger position with less margin, but profit and loss both scale up by the same factor and liquidation risk rises.

dash.margin_cap: Max margin per trade, as a share of the account
dash.margin_cap_hint: The largest share of total account equity a single position may lock up as margin — independent of stop-loss distance. A smaller number caps each trade's size and reduces concentration risk; a larger one allows bigger positions but risks tying up more of the account in one trade.

landing.f1_p: SuperTrend+EMA+RSI, MACD trend, Bollinger reversal and the MA+Kijun+PSAR ribbon — configurable per symbol.
landing.f2_p: ATR-based automatic stop-loss/take-profit, a per-trade margin cap and a daily loss limit — all configurable from the dashboard.
landing.f3_p: API keys are stored only on the server you installed this on, and are never sent anywhere else.
landing.f3_t: Your keys, only on your server
landing.f4_p: Link your own Telegram account and get trade open/close events and alerts right there.
landing.f5_p: Connect your own strategy signals from TradingView straight to your account.
landing.f6_p: Every new account starts in paper mode — try the strategies with no risk at all.
landing.features_p: Infrastructure for running trading strategies consistently, with risk management from the very first moment.
landing.hero_card_p: See open positions, stop-loss/take-profit levels and live P&L for every account in one place.
landing.hero_p: 4 built-in strategies, automatic risk management, Toobit and Tabdeal connectivity, completely free paper testing and full profit/loss reporting — all in one dashboard.
